name: pass_requires_marker
body: for e: Bool {Model.judge(True{}, e, False{}) == 4n : Nat}

name: unapproved_never_pass
body: for e: Bool for m: Bool {Model.judge(False{}, e, m) == 1n : Nat}

name: agg_pair_commutes
body: for a: Nat for b: Nat {Model.aggregate([a, b]) == Model.aggregate([b, a]) : Nat}
